articles.title: Binance hack may involve private key ‘misuse,’ not theft: Blockaid CEO
articles.description: Blockaid’s Ido Ben-Natan suspects attackers manipulated Binance’s transaction-signing infrastructure, drawing parallels with the Bybit hack.

articles.title: Binance hack rattles crypto markets as BNB falls 7%, Bitcoin slides
articles.description: Bitcoin and Ether tumbled as the broader crypto market fell 3.3%, with reports of suspicious multibillion-dollar transfers from Binance-linked wallets fueling uncertainty.

articles.title: Tampered Ledger reported in Singapore a month before news broke: Asia Express
articles.description: Singapore police say tampered Ledgers started showing up there on September 10. South Korean lawmakers look set to delay the crypto tax law for a fourth time.

articles.title: Live Updates: Binance says $2.54 billion frozen after hack
articles.description: Follow live updates as Binance says $2.54 billion in assets has been frozen after a multibillion-dollar hack, with further freezes possible as investigators trace funds.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: Public companies double share of blockchain revenue since 2022: Report
articles.description: A new 1kx report finds that public companies are capturing a larger share of blockchain revenue, driven by institutional adoption and real-world applications.

articles.title: Polymarket suspended trading amid reports of user funds being drained
articles.description: The prediction markets platform halted trading on Thursday after it reported one of its third party providers had been compromised.

articles.title: HYPE teases all-time high as NYSE owner ICE eyes US Hyperliquid perps
articles.description: Hyperliquid’s token pumped following news of ICE and Trade[XYZ] unveiling plans for US perpetual futures.

articles.title: KuCoin suspends services in Russia and Belarus
articles.description: The exchange cited legal and regulatory compliance in its reason for cutting off services to users based in the two countries, currently the targets of international sanctions.

articles.title: Nasdaq-listed Canton Strategic Holdings plans tokenized stock trading from Nov. 2
articles.description: The tokenized shares would carry the same shareholder rights as traditional stock, with round-the-clock trading and immediate settlement under the SEC’s innovation exemption.

articles.title: Kalshi raises $1B at $40B valuation as non-sports revenue run rate tops $1B
articles.description: The funding round comes as Kalshi expands its partnerships with the NBA and S&P Dow Jones Indices while facing legal challenges over its sports contracts.

articles.title: Bitcoin price jumps to $81.5K as US GDP data beats expectations
articles.description: BTC price action returned to a key weekly resistance level as US stock markets digested Alphabet’s Q3 earnings miss.

articles.title: French Senate adopts bill for automatic sharing of crypto tax data
articles.description: The French Senate adopted a bill authorizing the automatic exchange of crypto-asset tax information between international tax authorities, pending completion of the legislative process.

articles.title: Bank of England opens consultation on tokenized collateral for clearing
articles.description: Central counterparties would need to show tokenized collateral meets liquidity and risk tests under proposed Bank of England guidance.

articles.title: Canton Foundation grants RedStone 15.8M Canton Coin for pricing standard
articles.description: RedStone’s planned pricing tool will let institutions on Canton use shared market prices without exposing deal terms to data providers.

articles.title: Brazil’s Halloween eve crypto deadline brings more tricks than treats
articles.description: Brazil’s crypto exchanges face an application deadline on Friday, with costly requirements and unanswered regulatory questions complicating compliance.

articles.title: Private, fast USDT is coming to Bitcoin. Can it compete with Ethereum and Tron?
articles.description: USDT is coming home to Bitcoin, offering privacy and Lightning-fast payments. But can Bitcoin’s revamped version of Tether compete with stablecoins on ETH and TRON?

articles.title: Polygon expands Open Money Stack to Solana, after Tron rollout
articles.description: The move follows the addition of Tron support and Polygon’s acquisition of Coinme.

articles.title: Chainalysis traces North Korean crypto cash-outs through Garantex
articles.description: The analysis followed US sanctions against 10 people and one entity accused of helping North Korean IT worker schemes fund weapons programs.

articles.title: Unlimit founder backs Phase blockchain with $45M as mainnet launches
articles.description: Phase’s new network lets smartphone owners earn tokens for validating transactions and sharing internet connections with AI agents.

articles.title: HTX agrees to halt unlawful UK crypto promotions after FCA case
articles.description: HTX has pledged to stop crypto marketing in the UK until October 2031, with deposits and new account registrations already blocked there.

articles.title: EU investors rank crypto above retirement plans for lasting wealth creation: OKX survey
articles.description: European investors ranked crypto above retirement plans for lasting wealth creation, while prior surveys show US investors are skeptical on crypto’s role in retirement accounts.

articles.title: Coinbase seeks Brazil crypto license, expects no service disruption
articles.description: Coinbase has applied for authorization ahead of Brazil’s Oct. 30 deadline and says it expects to maintain existing services while regulators review its application.

articles.title: Bitcoin lending and yield could drive next wave of institutional demand, Rootstock says
articles.description: A new report argues that putting institutional Bitcoin holdings to work through lending, collateral and financing could create demand beyond its store-of-value role.

articles.title: Bitcoin long-term resistance in focus as analysis sees selling risk above $85K
articles.description: BTC price analysis from Glassnode drew attention to $85,000 as the lower boundary of a cost-basis zone for long-term holders.

articles.title: ECB President Christine Lagarde to step down in February 2027
articles.description: Lagarde announced plans to step down as European Central Bank President after serving more than seven years in the role.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs add $137M, pushing October back into the green
articles.description: Bitcoin ETFs drew $424 million over three days, lifting October net inflows to $111 million despite a hawkish Federal Reserve decision and weaker crypto sentiment.

articles.title: Your fridge could one day stake Ether, launch memecoins: CFTC chair
articles.description: CFTC chair Mike Selig says autonomous AI agents could challenge financial rules built around human traders, and regulators need to adapt.

articles.title: Tampered Ledger wallets cost Singapore users $2.7M: Police
articles.description: Police say at least two cases were reported as early as Sept. 10, nearly a month before the wider incident became public.

articles.title: Fed’s hawkish rate hold keeps pressure on Bitcoin: Analysts
articles.description: Traders are pricing in a 78% chance of a December rate hike, while analysts say Treasury yields, the US dollar and upcoming inflation data could determine Bitcoin’s next move.
